subject: [PATCH 1/2] mm/page_alloc: detect zonelist rebuilds from memory hot-add

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Approved the patch with a Reviewed-by tag, indicating that it addresses a legitimate issue and is technically sound.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: The patch addresses a spurious allocation failure caused by concurrent GFP_KERNEL and __GFP_THISNODE allocations when onlining the first block of a zone, particularly in configurations that rebuild zonelists after boot. It introduces a gate to check_retry_zonelist() based on CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTPLUG, which covers every configuration that rebuilds zonelists after boot.
